runs.question: What does the memo require agencies to do within 180 days?

answer.text: In OMB M-25-21, the 180-day deadline applies to two obligations. Within 180 days of the memo, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. Agencies must also produce a compliance document: each agency must submit to 0MB and post publicly on the agency's website either a plan to achieve consistency with this memorandum, or a written determination that the agency does not use and does not anticipate using covered AI. That compliance submission also has to include plans to update any existing internal AI principles and guidelines to ensure consistency with this memorandum.
